scenario_description:
Objective: Add optional public visibility for Saturday’s rain-garden mulching meetup through a free community-calendar mention.
Emerging Need: A radio opening appears while the meetup is still tentative, and the chance becomes useful only once walk-up capacity and a public access point are confirmed.
Decision Context: A stored media guide gives the copydesk address, deadline, and neutral wording constraints needed to judge whether a short notice is appropriate.
Consequence: Timely submission could draw extra neighbors without spending funds or changing the meetup; after copy closes, the event simply proceeds without the radio boost.

parameter.title: Riverside rain-garden mulching meetup
parameter.description: Tentative volunteer mulching session; public drop-in details and access point still pending parks crew confirmation.
parameter.location: Riverside rain garden - access point pending

parameter.subject: Unexpected opening in Friday morning community calendar
parameter.body: A sponsor segment cancellation opened one unpaid community-calendar slot for tomorrow morning’s rotation. Neighborhood hubs with ready, neutral public-service notices can be considered before today’s copy close; items without confirmed public details will be skipped.

parameter.content: Crew update: the east kiosk gate will be open for Saturday, and the mulch delivery is larger than expected. We can take walk-up neighbors at the 9:00 check-in if any notice uses the east kiosk and keeps it nonpartisan public-service wording.

parameter.title: Riverside rain-garden mulching meetup
parameter.location: Riverside Rain Garden east kiosk, 1200 Riverbend Way
parameter.description: Confirmed public mulching meetup with walk-up check-in at 9:00; volunteers bring gloves if they have them, and loaner tools are available while supplies last.

parameter.subject: Friday community calendar copy closed
parameter.body: The replacement slot for tomorrow morning's community-calendar rotation has been filled and the copy log is closed. Later neighborhood items can be considered for next week's rotations.
